description: The O&M curriculum is a planned teaching system, part of the Expanded Core Curriculum for visually impaired learners, that teaches independent and confident movement using other senses and equipment.
title: The O&M curriculum: mobility techniques, devices and the Expanded Core Curriculum

description: An eight-week preceptor education program developed and applied with 30 preceptor nurses at a Korean tertiary hospital through participatory action research.
title: OMP-based preceptor education program (PEP) developed through participatory action research
